_note: LLM-generated INTERACTION candidates (Claude as LLM): deliberately multiplicative (*), ratio (/), and time-series (TS_*) structures on the expanded 120-factor pool. Tests whether interaction factors survive the full chain as well as additive rank-sums.

factors.name: mispr_x_cashprof
factors.rationale: Multiplicative: the mispricing-management signal should matter more when backed by strong cash profitability (real earnings, not accrual illusion); disciplined equity issuance.

factors.name: value_x_quality
factors.rationale: Multiplicative: value and quality reinforce each other (cheap AND profitable, Novy-Marx / Asness), penalizing balance-sheet bloat (net operating assets).

factors.name: surprise_x_illiquidity
factors.rationale: Multiplicative: post-earnings-announcement drift is stronger among illiquid, limits-to-arbitrage stocks (Amihud); earnings surprise interacted with illiquidity, guarded against reversal.

factors.name: cashprof_per_investment
factors.rationale: Ratio: cash profitability per unit of asset growth isolates efficient profit generation without empire-building; low equity issuance.

factors.name: riskadj_momentum_disc
factors.rationale: Ratio: risk-adjusted momentum (information-ratio style) — momentum per unit realized volatility — combined with financing discipline.

factors.name: earnings_yield_stability
factors.rationale: Ratio: earnings yield scaled by earnings volatility rewards stable high-yield earners (quality of earnings-to-price), plus cash profitability.

factors.name: cashprof_trend_value
factors.rationale: Time-series: improving cash-profitability trend plus cheap valuation and low issuance captures underreacted quality recovery.

factors.name: persistent_mispricing_disc
factors.rationale: Time-series: persistent (not transient) mispricing combined with persistently low equity issuance identifies durable anomaly exposure.

factors.name: accrual_deterioration_guard
factors.rationale: Time-series: a rising 12-month change in operating accruals signals deteriorating earnings quality; combined with restrained asset growth and real cash profitability.

factors.name: profit_accel_x_value
factors.rationale: Time-series x multiplicative: a profitability improvement is worth more when the firm is cheap; tilt toward safe firms.
